claims.statement: Golden Template v1 is frozen after CĐ07 passed curriculum/schema/deploy QA and real iPad UX verification.
CĐ04, CĐ05 and CĐ06 each already have a 120-question Practice Bank; the batch must reuse existing skill IDs when they match curriculum intent.
CĐ06 Grade 8 Core explicitly excludes tach-hang-tu-giua.
Exact Learning Card count may vary by topic, but every Core card should have exactly 3 authored micro-practice items in Base -> Trap -> Apply order.

topic_specs.title: Biểu thức và biến đổi đại số
Phân tích đa thức thành nhân tử

proposed_changes.change: For each topic, return pedagogically coherent Core Learning Cards with title, KNTT scope, assessed skills, prerequisites/supporting skills, key concept, one worked example, misconception catalog and exactly 3 micro-practice specs per card.
proposed_changes.rationale: Generate the full Learn layer for the batch.

proposed_changes.change: Return all micro-practice items for all three topics in one packet. Every item must declare one assessed skill, optional supporting_skills, 4 plausible options, answer, explanation, hint ladder, and option-level observed_signal only when the distractor has a defensible primary interpretation.
proposed_changes.rationale: Preserve evidence semantics from Golden Template v1.

proposed_changes.change: For each topic, propose 8-12 Core written exercises with collapsible hint/solution, plus clearly separated Entrance10 and Challenge samples. Do not duplicate the 120-question interactive bank.
proposed_changes.rationale: Use written work for procedural fluency and presentation.

proposed_changes.change: For each topic, author 10-12 KNTT-Core MCQs balanced across confirmed Core skills. No hints/Tutor, one assessed skill per item, explanation shown only after Submit. Entrance10/Challenge must not contribute to Core readiness.
proposed_changes.rationale: Populate Assessment Engine v1 without introducing a second engine.

proposed_changes.change: List only dependency/remediation relations that need review. Do not promote pedagogical sequence to PREREQUISITE without necessity.

tests.expected: All three topics follow frozen Golden Template v1 invariants.
Every micro item has exactly one assessed skill and Base/Trap/Apply coverage per card.
CĐ06 tach-hang-tu-giua is absent from KNTT Core cards/readiness.
CĐ05 phan-tich-hdt/chung-minh-hdt/giai-phuong-trinh-hdt are not promoted to Core without explicit KNTT evidence.
CĐ04 bank skills marked layer-review are classified rather than assumed Core.
Canonical answers and worked solutions are independently recomputed before PASS.
No hard-gate or Mastered state is introduced.

uncertainties: Exact Core placement of CĐ04 lap-bieu-thuc/bai-toan-thuc-te and broader multi-step algebra should be source-checked rather than inferred from bank presence.
Some existing CĐ05/CĐ06 bank skills are useful Entrance10/application skills but are not automatically KNTT Core.
Do not create new Knowledge Graph nodes merely to encode a single distractor misconception.

acceptance.notes: Return ONE complete Collaboration Packet v2 covering CĐ04+CĐ05+CĐ06. Do not send card-by-card or topic-by-topic partial replies unless a source conflict blocks the whole batch.
